welcome.title: Hi Erica, I've been waiting for you!
welcome.text: Santa says he has a present for you, but he can't remember where he left it… Are you ready to find it?

questions.question: Santa is checking his list. Have you been naughty or nice?

answers.reply: Santa double-checked. He has some questions, but okay!
Honesty is very nice, so that cancels out!
Santa laughed so hard his belt popped.

questions.question: There is one last Christmas cookie. What do you do?

answers.reply: Crumbs on your scarf, but nobody saw a thing.
Half each! The bigger half is yours, of course.

questions.question: Who gives the best hugs in the whole world?

answers.reply: Correct! One free hug is on its way.
Also correct. I can confirm this personally.
Excellent idea. Testing may take all day.
